name: ax
one_liner: An early-stage, Kubernetes-style control system for running huge numbers of AI agent tasks safely in isolated sandboxes at once.
buyer: A platform engineer at a mid-size tech company who needs to run thousands of AI coding-agent jobs in parallel without them stepping on each other or leaking network access.
business_use_cases: An internal-tools team runs nightly 'AI agent does routine maintenance PRs across 500 repos' jobs, using it to sandbox and audit every run.
An AI coding-agent startup uses it as the execution backend so customer agent runs are isolated per-tenant instead of sharing one server.
A security team uses the network-fencing feature to run untrusted third-party agents against internal codebases without risking data exfiltration.

money_ideas.idea: Offer platform-engineering consulting to stand up an agent-orchestration cluster for a company adopting AI coding agents at scale.
Run a managed hosted version for smaller teams who don't want to operate the cluster themselves.

steal_this: This isn't weekend-project material — it's pre-1.0 infrastructure with breaking changes expected. The realistic 'steal this' is writing the missing 'getting started in 10 minutes' guide and selling setup consulting off the back of it.
